Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that submits an audio file for batch transcription using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import speech
from google.cloud import storage

def batch_transcribe_audio(gcs_uri: str, audio_channel_count: int = 1) -> speech.LongRunningRecognizeResponse:
    """Transcribes an audio file from Google Cloud Storage using the Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API
    in batch mode.

    Args:
        gcs_uri: The Google Cloud Storage URI of the audio file (e.g., "gs://cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.flac").
        audio_channel_count: The number of channels in the audio file. Defaults to 1.

    Returns:
        The LongRunningRecognizeResponse object containing the transcription results.
    """
    client = speech.SpeechClient()

    audio = speech.RecognitionAudio(uri=gcs_uri)
    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.FLAC,  # Adjust based on your audio file format
        sample_rate_hertz=16000,  # Adjust based on your audio file's sample rate
        language_code="en-US",
        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
        audio_channel_count=audio_channel_count,
        enable_separate_recognition_per_channel=True if audio_channel_count > 1 else False
    )

    # Use long_running_recognize for batch processing of longer audio files
    operation = client.long_running_recognize(config=config, audio=audio)

    print("Waiting for operation to complete...")
    response = operation.result(timeout=300)  # Wait for up to 300 seconds (5 minutes)

    return response
